statement: External validation pending due to lack of a legally verified independent dataset.

2_lighting.dataset_b: Indoor examination bay with fluorescent lighting
2_lighting.shift_risk: Shadow contrast variation affects edge activation.

3_background.dataset_a: High clutter: earthen floors, straw, corrugated tin
3_background.dataset_b: Clinical examination chutes and clean concrete hospital flooring
3_background.shift_risk: Reduced background clutter lowers false positive distractors.

4_framing.dataset_a: Pasture standoffs and oblique flank angles
4_framing.dataset_b: Close-up macro dermatology focused on primary lesions

5_presentation.dataset_b: Includes early ambulatory cases and subtle pre-eruptive papules
